comment.text: Title of the small centred dialog opened by clicking a suggestion chip in the create/edit AI project panel, where its label and prompt are changed. Verb phrase, imperative, short.

usage.context:
autoMaxHeight
 onClose={onClose}
 dataTestId="ai-project-suggestion-dialog"
 >
 <ModalDialog.Header>
 {suggestion ? t("Common:AIProjectEditSuggestion") : t("Common:AIProjectAddSuggestion")}
 </ModalDialog.Header>
 <ModalDialog.Body>
 <div className={styles.body}>
 <div className={styles.field}>
 <Text as="label" htmlFor="ai-project-suggestion-name" fontSize="13px" lineHeight="20px" fontWeight={600} noSelect>
